FOREWORD This Indian S t a n d a r d ( First Revision ) was a d o p t e d by the Bureau of Indian S t a n d a r d s , after the draft finalized by the Chemical Engineering Plants and Related Equipment Sectional C o m m i t t e e had been a p p r o v e d by the Heavy Mechanical Engineering Division Council. This Indian S t a n d a rd was first published in 1967. This revision has been b r o u g h t out to bring it in line with the latest industrial practice being followed in the c o u n t r y . In this revision following changes have been incorporated : a) Requirements for jaws a d d e d , and b) T h e information to be supplied by the purchaser and the manufacture r u p d a t e d . Jaw crushers are generally used for crushing rock and similar h a r d material and contain two rectangular surfaces of jaws, one of which alternately a p p r o a c h e s and recedes from the other. T h e jaws contain an angle and together with two side plates, enclose a wedge shaped cavity which is wider at the upper or feed end. The material which is fed at the u p p e r end gets crushed mainly by compression between the two jaws and discharges t h r o u g h the outlet. Particulars regarding information to be given to the m a n u f a c t u r e r by the purchaser with enquiry or o r d e r and the information to be furnished by the m a n u f a c t u r e r to the purchaser along with the q u o t a t i o n are given in Annex A and B respectively. For the p u r p o se of deciding whether a particular requirement of this s t a n d a r d is complied with, the final value, observed or calculated, expressing the result of a test or analysis, shall be r o u n d e d off in accordance with IS 2 : 1960 'Rule s for r o u n d i ng off numerical values ( revised )'. T h e n u m b e r of significant places retained in the rounded off value should be the same as that to the specified value in this standard

1 SCOPE This I n d i a n S t a n d a r d covers the jaw crushers which are c o m m o n l y used for crushing rocks 2 NOMENCLATURE 2.1 For the p u r p o s e of this standar d the various c o m p o n e n t s of the jaw crusher shall be designated as in Fig. 1. 2.1.1 Jaw Crusher 3.1.1 Depending Upon the Operating Mechanism a) Double-toggle jaw crusher -- A crushing machine o p e r a t i n g on the kinematic scheme as shown in Fig. 2 wherein the moving jaw possesses a simple motion of a p p r o a c h i n g to and receding from the fixed jaw into linear p a t h . b) Single-toggle jaw crusher -- A crushing machine operating on the kinematic scheme as shown in Fig. 3 wherein the moving jaw possesses a c o m p o u n d motion. 3.1.2 Depending Upon the Size of the Jaws a) Jaw crusher with normal width, where the ratio l/b is between 1.4 and 1.6, where 1 and b denote respectively the width of the jaw and m i n i m um feed gap respectively. b) Jaw crusher with extended width, where the ratio l / b is between 2.2 and 5.7, where 1 and b denot e respectively the width of the jaw and m i n i m u m feed gap respectively.

A machin e for crushing rock mainly by compression between two rectangular surfaces or jaws, o n e of which ( rarely both ) alternately a p p r o a c h e s and recedes from the other. 3 CLASSIFICATION 3.1 For the p u r p o s e of this standard jaw crushers shall be classified as follows

4 SIZE T h e size of the jaw crusher shall be designated by the jaw width a n d the charging gap width in millimetres. 5 DESIGNATION The designation include: of a jaw crusher shall

8.1 T h e i m m o v a b l e jaw shall be hinged so that it could be removed in case of chokin g d u r i n g o p e r a t i o n . This shall be d o n e by hinges and locking nut-bolt a r r a n g e m e n t which shall be used to open fixed jaw to release the choked material. This shall be provided at least for small capacity jaw crushers. 8.2 Both the jaw plates shall be provided with rough surface to increase the grip on the crushin g material and to minimize the slipping of material.

ANNEX A ( Foreword )
I N F O R M A T I O N TO BE S U P P L I F D BY T H E P U R C H A S E R TO T H E MANUFACTURER WITH T H E E N Q U I R Y A N D ORDER A-1 T h e enquiry and should state: a) Material; b) Bulk density, tonnes/m 3 ; c) 1) Type of material (Hygroscopic, soft, brittle, etc ); 2) Moistur e contents, percent; d) S t r u c t u re of material ( crystalline, granular , flaky ); order by the purchaser e) Crushing strength, if possible, N / m 2 ; f) Feed size, mm; g) Chemical p r o p e r t y , corrosion with iron, etc; h) Product size, mm; j) Capacity of crusher required, t o n n e s / h o u r ; k) Ultimate use of material (Permissibility of iron in product ); and m) Any other remarks.

I N F O R M A T I O N TO BE F U R N I S H E D BY T H E MANUFACTURE R TO THE P U R C H A S E R ALONG WITH THE Q U O T A T I O N A N D S U P P L Y B-1 The manufacture r shall give the following information along with his quotation and supply: a) Size and designation ( Single-toggle/double-toggle, hinged/fixed j a w , type of grooves on p l a t e s ) ; b) M a x i m u m feed opening, m m ; c) M i n i m u m and m a x i m u m opening at the b o t t o m of jaw, m m ; d) M a x i m u m recommended feed size, mm; e) Capacity of crusher with respect to discharge opening, tonnes/h; f) Energy consumed to crush the material k W / t o n n e ; and g) Material of construction with regard to the following major c o m p o n e n t s of the jaw crusher: 1) F r a m e , 2) Swing jaw, 3) Swing jaw shaft, 4) Pitman, 5) Pitman shaft, 6) Pitman shaft bearing, 7) Jaw plates, 8) Cheek plates, 9) Toggle, and 10) Fly wheel.

ANNEX C ( Clause 7.1 )
I N F O R M A T I O N TO BE GIVEN IN THE CERTIFICATE BY T H E M A N U F A C T U R E R TO T H E P U R C H A S E R AT THE TIME OF S U P P L Y I N G M A C H I N E C-1 I N S P E C T I ON C-1.1 The inspection report shall state that each part of the crusher has been inspected before painting to ensure that it is free from any visible defects in casting, machining, etc. C-2 T E S T - R U N C-2.1 T h e test-run report shall state: a) The n u m b e r of hours the crusher has been
3

run continuously under no load after completion of the assembly, and b) That after dismantling the crusher after the trial run inspection has been carried out to ensure that: 1) The construction of the crusher is satisfactory, 2) Lubricating condition is satisfactory, 3) There is no slackness or unusual wear on any c o m p o n e n t , and 4) The bearings are evenly loaded.
